instruct: Male, about 45 years old, low warm baritone with a smooth velvety timbre, clean, no hoarseness, close to the microphone. Native Russian speaker. An engaging history storyteller who draws the listener in: calm confident authority, expressive melody with wide rises and falls, emphasis on key words, fluent brisk delivery inside sentences, a clear short pause after each sentence.
